name: Visa on Arrival / Visa-Exempt Entry

requirements.blocker_text: Nationals of visa-exempt countries may enter without a visa; nationals of Visa-on-Arrival-eligible countries may obtain one on entry (also available as an e-VOA in advance via evisa.imigrasi.go.id). Others must obtain a visit visa in advance.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for an e-VOA or visit visa if not visa-exempt.

outcome.duration_length: 30 days, extendable once for a further 30 days (VOA); up to 60-90 days for some visit visa categories

sources.title: Direktorat Jenderal Imigrasi -- official eVisa portal, visa-exempt/VOA/visit-visa selection

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Indonesia's initial build. Most of imigrasi.go.id's own main-domain pages returned HTTP 403 to automated fetching throughout this build; the eVisa subdomain (evisa.imigrasi.go.id) was more consistently reachable and is used as the primary tier-1 source across this country's routes. Exact visa-exempt/VOA country lists and precise duration-by-category were not exhaustively itemised in this pass.
